title: Phone ka Battery % Sensor Nahi Padhta, Calculate Hota Hai 🔋 #shorts
description:
Phone mein battery % koi sensor seedha nahi padhta!
Ye sirf ek estimate hai, jo current aur voltage se calculate hota hai.
🔋 Shunt resistor 0.1 Ω par voltage drop naapta hai
⚡ 12-bit ADC se number banta hai, I2C se jaata hai
📏 Default range ±3.2 A, bus voltage 0–26 V
🧮 Coulomb counting drift karti hai, isliye % sirf estimate
Subscribe karo Echo Lab 3D, har hafte ek module kholke dekhenge!
#shorts #INA219 #Arduino #Electronics #BatteryPercentage #Hinglish #Makers #ESP32
